name: TED Search API v3 and official notice downloads
owner: Publications Office of the European Union

access.rate_limit_description: Search API pagination is bounded to 250 notices and 10000 fields per page; iteration mode supports complete result traversal. Direct visualisation/download fair-use limits are separate and must not be conflated with Search API limits.

rights.notes: TED states that procurement notices in the OJ S may generally be reused for commercial or non-commercial purposes. SIMAP metadata is CC0 and editorial website content is CC BY 4.0. Reuse remains conditional on attribution, indication of changes, non-distortion, personal-data minimisation, third-party rights and exclusion of protected logos or industrial-property content. This source record authorises only a transient technical probe and frozen non-personal fixtures; it does not admit customer display, export, API redistribution or model training.

freshness.expected_cadence: Weekday OJ S publication; official TED daily XML package available by 09:30 on publication days according to the source help page.
